method: ENTIRELY from ONE AMH page, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED. No passage reproduced, no source_text stored, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable and every statement must be verified by a person against a current subscription. ⚠️ THIS IS A SHORT PAGE WHOSE CONTENT IS ALMOST ENTIRELY NEGATIVE -- what NOT to use, and that the evidence for the alternatives is limited. NO DOSE APPEARS. It is recorded at that length rather than padded.

claims.claim: ⚠️ THE ROUTINE USE OF DOPAMINERGIC DRUGS -- CABERGOLINE AND BROMOCRIPTINE -- IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR SUPPRESSING PHYSIOLOGICAL LACTATION. THEY MAY BE USED TO PREVENT ONSET OF LACTATION IN THE PUERPERIUM FOR CLEARLY DEFINED MEDICAL REASONS. CABERGOLINE IS PREFERRED AS IT HAS FEWER SIDE EFFECTS THAN BROMOCRIPTINE
